# Frozen reference fixtures

These files were generated by the Python lattice and model kit of the
skilledwolf/alpsx fork (branch `agent/v3-execution-and-api-audit`,
f8ee6e98b, `src/model/tests/{lattice,models}/fixtures/`) and are kept as
frozen reference data. They are not regenerated by this repository.

`lattice/*.fixture` describe a tiled lattice: `dimension`, `extent`,
`boundary`, `alps_name`, one `site` line per site (index, site type,
sublattice, coordinates), one `bond` line per bond in construction order
(source, target, bond type, wraps flag, bond vector) and `momentum` rows.
The `param` lines and the `toml-begin`/`toml-end` block record the legacy
parameter bridge and TOML emitter of the original kit, which were not
ported; the tests skip them.

`models/*.fixture` describe a compiled model: `site_dims`, `site_types`,
the conserved quantum numbers, one `term` line per compiled term
(coefficient, factor sites, Jordan–Wigner sites) followed by one `op` line
per factor (dimension, row-major complex entries), and the ground-state
energy `e0` of the densely assembled Hamiltonian.
